units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:11">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>לצפור … ביד צ׳</he> this is to be compared to a bird in the hand of a fowler.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:6">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 12:27">Prov. XII, 27</cite> <he>י̇ח̇ר̇ך̇</he>) <he>לא י̇ח̇יה ולא יאר̇יך̇ ימים צ׳ הרמאי</he> the tricky hunter (the student whose object is to dazzle people with his erudition) shall not live and prolong his days; <cite ref="Proverbs 12:27">ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ הרמאי יחרוך</he> the shrewd hunter (the student that tries to learn and retain as much as possible) will roast his game (will become a scholar); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19a:17">Ab. Zar. 19ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>משל לצ׳ שצד וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לאדם</he>) like a fowler that catches many birds &c.; Erub. l. c.
